description: This file defines a base reporter class for test result reporting in Playwright, including output formatting, error handling, and summary generation.

classes.name: TerminalReporter
classes.description: A class implementing a test reporter that outputs test results to a terminal, including summaries, failures, and slow tests.

methods.name: formatFailure
methods.description: Formats a detailed failure report for a test, including error messages and attachments.

methods.name: formatRetry
methods.description: Formats output for a test retry.

methods.name: relativeFilePath
methods.description: Computes relative file path based on configuration and screen resolve setting.

methods.name: stepSuffix
methods.description: Generates a suffix string for test steps.

methods.name: formatTestTitle
methods.description: Creates a formatted test title string including project, location, and tags.

methods.name: formatTestHeader
methods.description: Creates a formatted header for a test, optionally including error mode details.

methods.name: formatError
methods.description: Formats a test error into a detailed message with stack trace and snippets.

methods.name: separator
methods.description: Creates a separator line for terminal output.

methods.name: prepareErrorStack
methods.description: Parses and prepares an error stack trace for display.

methods.name: fitToWidth
methods.description: Truncates a line to fit within a specified width, preserving formatting.
